status: theoretical specification; locally sealed before descriptive target audit; no model implementation, training or registration
information: H_i contains only history available at origin i; no historical next-token loss on origin-normalized context
training: teacher forcing with true prior codes only
generation: use generated codes only; no unknown true future price/state
joint: product over h=1..20 of p(k[h] | H_i,k[1],...,k[h-1])
sampling: central cells plus two tail categories, then rounded truncated Gaussian within selected tail
reconstruction_bound: abs(u_hat[h]-log(P[i+h])) <= delta/2 in exact arithmetic, synchronized true-code states

sufficient_joint_first_moment_conditions.constants: M=256,S=64,A=4 proposed; S=256 sensitivity; sigma_min=.25; not fitted

open: Stable log interval probabilities, derivatives, normalizer and tail sampler; no network or full head numerical audit
Finite arithmetic range for cumulative codes, embeddings and exp(price)
Head expressiveness, possible Gaussian tail misspecification and bounded-parameter saturation
Optimization budget, compute-balanced controls and tests of gradients
Native-price scoring with Monte Carlo diagnostics and independent multi-market evaluation
recurrence_equivalence: Identical to closed-loop DPCM in exact arithmetic; floating recurrence compared in separate audit

bounds_proposal.rationale: Provisional fixed design: one k unit is s_i/8, so mean bound 32*s_i and sd bound 8*s_i; not empirically validated.
bounds_proposal.parameter_initialization: output matrices zero; g_mu and correction biases zero; g_sigma bias log((8-.25)/(64-8))
bounds_proposal.sensitivity_status: hypotheses only; no tuning or predictive comparison executed
bounds_proposal.uniform_joint_moment_bound: conditional on origin and fixed finite delta; not uniform across all possible origins

architecture.shared_input_across_heads: Q affine past encoder from P1-D 0.4; no simultaneous comparison of past encoders
architecture.loss_positions: BOS predicts k1; token n[h]/8 predicts k[h+1], h=1..19; no history loss
architecture.future_numeric_value: n[h]/8, derived only from previous true codes in teacher forcing, own sampled codes in generation
architecture.future_calendar_gap: zero sentinel meaning unknown, distinguished by FUTURE type; no true future calendar information
architecture.future_metadata: log(P_i), log(s_i), log1p(0), indicator n[h] outside [-2048,2047]
architecture.bos_metadata: same origin constants, gap=0, escape=0; numeric value=0; BOS type
architecture.past_metadata: P1-D four fields; history gap and escape of the past Q code
architecture.shared_modules: P1-D blocks, fixed sinusoidal positions, numeric affine 2d, asset embeddings 6d, four-feature affine 5d, final layernorm 2d, three type embeddings 3d

FLAT.meaning: mu,sigma and 4096 independent central correction logits

HIER.meaning: mu,sigma,512 coarse outputs and 3 pairs of bit outputs; g_k=g_q+sum(g_bit); q=floor(k/8), three remainder bits

architecture.correction_gauge: HIER additive component parameters not identifiable; counts are allocated weights, not independent function dimensions
architecture.heads_not_information_equivalent: same conditioning data and base; distinct function classes and capacities
architecture.head_matrix_flops_per_origin: 2*20*d*r, r in {2,4098,520}; excludes nonlinearities, 4096 cell weights/CDFs and normalization
architecture.block_forward_flops_per_origin: L*(24*n*d*d+4*n*n*d), n=276, dense attention; excludes softmax/LN/activations and backward
architecture.precision: future integer state exact in mathematical contract; finite-range and float32 embedding conversion must be audited before implementation; no universal machine-precision guarantee
architecture.unseen_output_codes: normalizer creates gradients for codes not observed as positive targets; do not apply frozen-unvisited-input-table policy to output heads

scoring.proposed_training: mean negative log conditional code mass over 20 future steps
scoring.interpretation: proper likelihood for this fixed discretized path law, not a price-density likelihood
scoring.quantizer_comparison: NLL across different delta or rounding rules not directly comparable
scoring.price_evaluation: native-price pinball and calibration versus P1-D baseline; MC accuracy protocol still open
scoring.within_cell_price_law: not specified; decoded lattice prices are a discrete forecast law, not a calibrated law of all real prices
